lines.en: label ayanesanabeach1:
I tap on Ayane’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Ayane 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: Given that she’s normally out and about early in the morning, I figure that meeting up with her might be the start to my day I need after the SERIES OF HORRIBLE NIGHTMARES uninteresting dreams I had last night.
lines.zh: 考虑到她平时一大早就在外面到处跑，我想，在经历了昨晚那一连串 SERIES OF HORRIBLE NIGHTMARES——我是说，无聊的梦之后，跟她见一面也许正是我这一天需要的开场。

lines.en: Here’s hoping that she is still alive.
lines.zh: 希望她还活着吧。

lines.en: : Sensei! Good morning!
lines.zh: : Sensei！早上好！

lines.en: She is.
lines.zh: 她活着。

lines.en: : Good morning, Ayane. What are you up-
lines.zh: : 早上好，Ayane。你在忙什么——

lines.en: : Are you home right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在在家吗？

lines.en: : What? Yes. I just woke-
lines.zh: : 什么？在啊。我刚醒——

lines.en: : Good! I’ll be there in thirty seconds. Get dressed.
lines.zh: : 很好！我三十秒后到。去换衣服。

lines.en: : What? Thirty seconds?
lines.zh: : 什么？三十秒？

lines.en: : I don’t have time to explain!
lines.zh: : 我没时间解释！

lines.en: : Well...why not? Because the fact that you’re only thirty seconds away means-
lines.zh: : 呃……为什么没有？因为你说你离我只有三十秒路程，这意味着——

lines.en: : I don’t have time to explain why I don’t have time to explain! Now get dressed! And pack a swimsuit!
lines.zh: : 我没时间解释我为什么没时间解释！快去换衣服！还有，带上泳衣！

lines.en: : A swimsuit?
lines.zh: : 泳衣？

lines.en: : Fifteen seconds!
lines.zh: : 还剩十五秒！

lines.en: I hang up the phone and frantically begin to search for my clothes, only to remember that I keep all three of my shirts in the same drawer- directly above the drawer I keep my pants and swim trunks in.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，手忙脚乱地开始找衣服，这才想起我那三件衬衫都放在同一个抽屉里——就在我放裤子和泳裤的抽屉正上方。

lines.en: scene ayanebeachtrip1
Having all of the required equipment (But still only a vague idea of what is going on), I make my way into the living room.
lines.zh: 装备齐了（但对到底发生了什么仍然只有个模糊的概念），我走进了客厅。

lines.en: As soon as I go to reach for the door, though, Ami’s niece alarm goes off and she comes running out of her bedroom to catch me before I head out.
lines.zh: 可我刚要伸手去开门，Ami 的“侄女警报”就响了，她从卧室里冲出来，在我出门前把我拦下。

lines.en: scene ayanebeachtrip2
: What’s going on? You haven’t even eaten breakfast yet. Why are you leaving in such a hurry?
lines.zh: : 怎么回事？你连早饭都还没吃呢。干嘛这么急着出门？

lines.en: : I think Ayane is coordinating a kidnapping of me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Ayane 正在策划一场对我的绑架。

lines.en: : Ayane is...what?
lines.zh: : Ayane 在……什么？

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure I am about to be dragged to the beach. Or...pool. Or any other place that requires a swimsuit.
lines.zh: : 我基本可以确定，我马上要被拖去海边了。或者……泳池。或者任何需要穿泳衣的地方。

lines.en: scene ayanebeachtrip3
: What?! But I have work today! You guys aren’t allowed to have fun on days that I have work!
lines.zh: : 什么？！可我今天要上班啊！我上班的日子，你们不许出去玩！

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Ami. But this is beyond my control. It’s already been a full minute since I called her, which is twice as long as the amount of time I was given to get out of the house.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Ami。但这已经超出我的控制范围了。我给她打完电话已经整整一分钟了，是我被限定出门时间的两倍。

lines.en: : Sensei! You’ve had twice as long to get ready as I gave you! Hurry up!
lines.zh: : Sensei！我给你的准备时间已经是我说的两倍了！快点！

lines.en: : See? She’s already here.
lines.zh: : 你看？她都已经到了。

lines.en: scene ayanebeachtrip4
: Go away, Ayane! Sensei is too busy loving me to-
lines.zh: : 走开，Ayane！Sensei 忙着爱我，没空——

lines.en: scene black
: Sorry, Ami! No time to argue! I’ll be taking your uncle now!
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Ami！没时间吵了！你舅舅我今天先带走了！

lines.en: : Stop! Thief!
lines.zh: : 站住！抓贼啊！

lines.en: : I’ll make it up to you by providing you your very own Sensei clone once I figure out the technology!
lines.zh: : 等我把技术搞明白，我会赔你一个专属的 Sensei 克隆体！

lines.en: : I want three!
lines.zh: : 我要三个！

lines.en: : Hey, we have the same fantasy!
lines.zh: : 嘿，我们的幻想一模一样！

lines.en: : Anyway, bye! See you tomorrow!
lines.zh: : 总之，拜拜！明天见！

lines.en: Ayane grabs my wrist and is somehow strong enough to pull me out of the doorway and...
lines.zh: Ayane 一把抓住我的手腕，力气大得居然能把我从门口拽出去，然后……

lines.en: scene ayanebeachtrip5
...Into the backseat of a limo?
lines.zh: ……拽进了一辆豪华轿车的后座？

lines.en: : This seems excessive. And unnecessarily fast-paced.
lines.zh: : 这有点夸张了。而且节奏快得没必要。

lines.en: : I probably could have slowed down a bit, but things were more fun this way.
lines.zh: : 我本来也许可以慢一点的，但这样更有意思。

lines.en: : I’m glad you called me when you did. Any later and we would have already passed your house.
lines.zh: : 幸好你打电话的时机刚刚好。再晚一点，我们就已经开过你家了。

lines.en: : I seem to be riding in cars a lot more than normal lately and I can’t say I like it.
lines.zh: : 最近我坐车的次数好像比平常多太多了，我可说不上喜欢。

lines.en: : Don’t worry. Geoffrey is a great driver from all the time he spent working for Al Capone back in the day.
lines.zh: : 别担心。Geoffrey 是个很棒的司机，他当年可是给 Al Capone 开过车的。

lines.en: : Wait, how old is Geoffrey?
lines.zh: : 等等，Geoffrey 多大了？

lines.en: : That doesn’t matter. What does matter is that we’re going to the beach!
lines.zh: : 那不重要。重要的是我们要去海边了！

lines.en: : Yeah, I kind of figured as much. Why so early, though?
lines.zh: : 嗯，我大概猜到了。不过为什么这么早？

lines.en: : Because having an entire day full of fun is better than having...only part of the day full of fun?
lines.zh: : 因为一整天都充满乐趣，总比……只有半天充满乐趣好吧？

lines.en: : Well, I’m glad that Sana seems to be getting a head start.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我看 Sana 倒是起跑得挺早。

lines.en: scene ayanebeachtrip6
: Can’t talk...in the zone!
lines.zh: : 别跟我说话……进入状态了！

lines.en: : Sana got a new game for her Switch and refused to take her eyes off of it all morning.
lines.zh: : Sana 的 Switch 上多了个新游戏，一早上眼睛都不肯离开屏幕。

lines.en: : Originally, the plan was for just the two of us to go to the beach together, hence her uncharacteristically showy outfit. But, seeing as she has abandoned me, it looks like it’s the two of us now.
lines.zh: : 本来计划是我俩单独去海边的，所以她才穿了那身反常地招摇的衣服。不过，既然她把我抛下了，现在看来就是我们俩了。

lines.en: scene ayanebeachtrip7
: Is that okay?
lines.zh: : 这样可以吗？

lines.en: : Does asking me even matter when I have already been borderline kidnapped?
lines.zh: : 在我已经被半绑架的情况下，问我还有意义吗？

lines.en: : No. It does not.
lines.zh: : 没有。一点也没有。

lines.en: : But I’m primed and ready to make up for this inconvenience by giving you a first look at my brand new swimsuit.
lines.zh: : 不过我已经准备好了，要用我全新泳衣的首次亮相来弥补给你添的麻烦。

lines.en: : But I liked your old swimsuit.
lines.zh: : 可我喜欢你原来那件泳衣。

lines.en: : This one shows significantly more skin.
lines.zh: : 这件露的皮肤多多了。

lines.en: : The old swimsuit sucks. I like the new one now.
lines.zh: : 那件旧泳衣糟透了。我现在喜欢新的了。

lines.en: : Just make sure you stare a little more at me than you stare at Sana, okay? Because she got a new one too and I don’t want my painstaking selection process to have been for nothing.
lines.zh: : 那你保证，盯着我看的时间要比盯着 Sana 看的时间多一点，好吗？因为她也买了件新的，我可不想我那费尽心思的挑选过程白费。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure Sana wouldn’t even know that I’m staring at her at this point, but...sure. For your sake, I’ll make sure to spend the bulk of my time looking at you.
lines.zh: : 我看这会儿 Sana 大概根本不会注意到我在看她，不过……好吧。看在你的份上，我保证大部分时间都盯着你看。

lines.en: : Silence! You are...making it hard to aim!
lines.zh: : 安静！你们……害我瞄不准了！

lines.en: scene ayanebeachtrip8
: Sana, it’s just Splatoon. Would it really kill you to-
lines.zh: : Sana，那只是 Splatoon 而已。你就不能——

lines.en: scene ayanebeachtrip9
: JUST SPLATOON?!
lines.zh: : 只是 SPLATOON？！

lines.en: : DO YOU HAVE ANY IDEA WHAT YOU JUST SAID?!
lines.zh: : 你知不知道你刚才说了什么？！

lines.en: : THIS IS SPLATOON 3! IT’S THE SECOND SEQUEL, AYANE! THE THIRD INSTALLMENT OF A TRILOGY! COME ON!
lines.zh: : 这是 SPLATOON 3！是第二部续作，Ayane！三部曲的第三部！拜托！

lines.en: : R...Right...
: Sorry...
lines.zh: : 抱歉……

lines.en: scene black
Sana immediately goes back to ignoring us and focusing on her game, prompting Ayane and me to figure out what to spend the rest of the drive talking about.
lines.zh: Sana 立刻重新无视我们，专心打她的游戏，于是 Ayane 和我开始琢磨剩下的车程该聊点什么。

lines.en: Having never been in the same place at the same time as him before, I attempt to usher Geoffrey into the conversation as well but, unfortunately, find that the window in the back of the limo is stuck shut.
lines.zh: 我以前从没跟他同时同地待过，于是试着把 Geoffrey 也拉进对话，可惜发现轿车后座的窗户卡死了，打不开。

lines.en: I accept that I may never get another chance to speak to him and just focus on Ayane’s detailed explanation of his backstory instead.
lines.zh: 我接受了自己可能再也没有机会跟他说话这件事，转而专心听 Ayane 详细讲述他的身世。

lines.en: Unfortunately for you, that backstory is far too graphic. So I will keep all of the details to myself and patiently await the opportunity to see two adorable girls in revealing clothing.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是，那段身世实在太不堪入目了。所以细节我就都自己留着了，只是耐心地等着看两个穿着清凉的可爱女孩。

lines.en: scene ayanebeachtrip10
Boy, did all of that patiently waiting pay off.
lines.zh: 乖乖，这一番耐心的等待可真是值回票价。

lines.en: : What do you think? Still like the new swimsuit more? Or do I seem like more of a one-piece girl after getting a look at both of them?
lines.zh: : 你觉得怎么样？还是更喜欢新泳衣吗？还是说，两件都看过之后，你觉得我更像个适合连体款的人？

lines.en: : I think this new one works a lot better. And no, that is not me being biased or generally favorable of anything that shows me more of your body at once.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这件新的效果好多了。而且不，这不是我有偏见，也不是我一味偏袒任何能让我一次看到你更多身体的东西。

lines.en: : I’d ask for a more in-depth description of your thoughts on my body but, unfortunately, it appears that Sana is taking a short break from Splatoon 3 to hear what you have to say about her swimsuit.
lines.zh: : 我本来还想让你更深入地描述一下对我身体的看法，可惜，Sana 似乎正从《Splatoon 3》里短暂抽身，来听听你对她泳衣的评价。

lines.en: : I...I don’t really...have to know what Sensei thinks...
lines.zh: : 我……我真的……不一定要知道 Sensei 怎么想……

lines.en: : I...obviously...can’t pull...off this kind of thing as well as you...so...
lines.zh: : 我……显然……没办法像你一样……撑得起这种东西……所以……

lines.en: : Interesting choice, Sana. What prompted you to follow Ayane’s example and start revealing more of yourself if you’re still uncomfortable with that?
lines.zh: : 有意思的选择，Sana。既然你还是这么不自在，是什么让你跟着 Ayane 的榜样，开始把自己露得更多了？

lines.en: scene ayanebeachtrip11
: Um...p...peer pressure?...
lines.zh: : 呃……同……同侪压力？……

lines.en: : Character...development?...
lines.zh: : 角色……成长？……

lines.en: : Thinking that...it was just going to be...Ayane and me?...
lines.zh: : 以为……就只是……我和 Ayane 两个人？……

lines.en: : Well, whichever one of your many potential reasons it may be...I support it. I think you look just as cute as Ayane.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不管你这诸多潜在理由是哪一个……我都支持。我觉得你和 Ayane 一样可爱。

lines.en: scene ayanebeachtrip12
: I think...um...you’re...an idiot...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……呃……你是个……白痴……

lines.en: : And I think I’m just never going to compliment you again.
lines.zh: : 那我觉得我以后再也不会夸你了。

lines.en: : That works out beautifully! Because that means Sana can go back to playing her game while the two of us get some sun!
lines.zh: : 那可太完美了！因为这意味着 Sana 可以继续打她的游戏，我们两个去晒太阳！

lines.en: : I’m not a fan of the sun. But you go ahead and have fun, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我不太喜欢太阳。不过你去玩吧，Ayane。

lines.en: : Nope! Not letting you off that easily, Sensei. If you don’t get some vitamin D every once in a while, you’re going to die early. And I’ll be damned if I have to bury you before our thirtieth anniversary.
lines.zh: : 不行！我不会这么轻易放过你的，Sensei。你要是不偶尔补点维生素 D，会早死的。我可不想在咱们三十周年纪念之前就得埋了你。

lines.en: : I’ve got some vitamin D for you right here.
lines.zh: : 我这儿就有点维生素 D 给你。

lines.en: : God, I wish.
lines.zh: : 天哪，真希望是。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Okay...I’m going to leave now...
lines.zh: : 好吧……我先走了……

lines.en: scene ayanebeachtrip13
: Bye, Sana! Remember to put on sunscreen! And to not accept any candy from strangers!
lines.zh: : 拜拜，Sana！记得涂防晒霜！还有别收陌生人的糖！

lines.en: : I’m just going to...find somewhere dark and...shady to...ignore everyone...
lines.zh: : 我就是要去……找个又黑又……阴凉的地方……无视所有人……

lines.en: Sana disappears behind the bathroom and, once again, Ayane and I are on our own.
lines.zh: Sana 消失在洗手间后面，于是又剩下 Ayane 和我两个人。

lines.en: scene black
My rich blonde “princess” and the newest member of our unnamed apocalypse squad takes this as a cue to head closer to the water, once again grabbing my wrist and pulling me along beside her.
lines.zh: 我那位富有的金发“公主”、也是咱们那个还没命名的末日小队的最新成员，把这当成了往水边走的信号，再一次抓住我的手腕，把我拽到她身边。

lines.en: It’s a lot more gentle and a lot less urgent this time, though- like a way for her to be closer to me without having to use words or spread her legs.
lines.zh: 不过这一次温柔多了，也没那么急切了——像是她不用开口、也不用张开腿，就能离我更近一点的方式。

lines.en: And while methods like that last one are a lot easier for me to understand and feel, I don’t hate the sensation of her small hand slowly inching closer to mine.
lines.zh: 虽然像最后那种方式对我来说更容易理解、也更容易感受，但我并不讨厌她那只小手慢慢往我手上蹭过来的触感。

lines.en: Nor the scent of her sunscreen or the shape of her silhouette as it slithers across the sand like a snake.
lines.zh: 也不讨厌她防晒霜的味道，或是她像蛇一样滑过沙滩时的身形轮廓。

lines.en: scene ayanebeachtrip14
We come to a halt where the water meets the land and I try to wrap my head around why God the gods? GOD god can’t just make it a few degrees colder.
lines.zh: 我们在水与陆相接的地方停下，我努力想弄明白，为什么 God the gods? GOD god 就不能把温度调低个几度。

lines.en: You know- enough to keep us all alive but not enough to scorch our skin or give us cancer if we stay beneath it for too long.
lines.zh: 你知道的——够冷到让我们都活着，但又不至于把我们的皮肤烤焦，或者待久了得皮肤癌。

lines.en: But in thinking this, I realize that my mind has strayed so far from the path it’s meant to walk that it takes every ounce of self-control I have to not create a distraction in the form of a hand inside of Ayane’s swimsuit.
lines.zh: 但想着这些，我意识到自己的思绪已经偏离它该走的轨道太远，我得用尽全部自制力，才能不把一只手伸进 Ayane 的泳衣里，来给自己制造点分心。

lines.en: : I really love the summer, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我真的很喜欢夏天，Sensei。

lines.en: : You’re insane.
lines.zh: : 你疯了。

lines.en: : I know you’re more of a winter person. But weather like this is actually perfect for me. There’s just something about the way the heat hits my skin that makes me...I don’t know. Comfortable?
lines.zh: : 我知道你更偏向冬天。但这种天气对我来说其实刚刚好。热气打在皮肤上的那种感觉，就是让我……我也说不上来。舒服？

lines.en: : The only problem is now I don’t know whether or not it’s even real.
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是，现在我不知道这到底是真是假。

lines.en: : What do you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 你这话什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that Christmas is only a couple months away and it still feels like the height of summer.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，圣诞节也就剩几个月了，可现在感觉还是盛夏。

lines.en: : Isn’t that kind of...weird?
lines.zh: : 这不觉得有点……怪吗？

lines.en: : At this rate, we might even wind up having our annual Christmas party right here on the beach.
lines.zh: : 照这个速度，我们说不定最后会把一年一度的圣诞派对直接开在这片海滩上。

lines.en: : There’s another suspicious element to that last sentence I’m not even sure if you’ve grasped yet. But you’re on the right track.
lines.zh: : 你最后那句话里还有个可疑的点，我甚至不确定你自己有没有意识到。不过方向是对的。

lines.en: : Is it the fact that we’re only a short while away from Christmas party number three despite still being first years? Because I’ve been thinking a lot about that lately too.
lines.zh: : 你是说，尽管我们还只是一年级，圣诞派对却已经要办第三届了？因为最近我也一直在想这件事。

lines.en: : There are...all sorts of weird things going on with this timeline, aren’t there?
lines.zh: : 这条时间线上……有各种各样奇怪的事在发生，对吧？

lines.en: : Bingo.
lines.zh: : 答对了。

lines.en: : I assume that’s just more...infinite loop fuckery?
lines.zh: : 我猜那也只是更多……无限循环的狗屁。

lines.en: : I assume so as well. I also don’t know if I like the sound of you cursing without my penis inside of you. It’s rare.
lines.zh: : 我也这么猜。另外我也不确定，我喜不喜欢听你在没有我那话儿在你体内的时候说脏话。这可稀罕。

lines.en: : Less rare than your penis being inside of me at this point.
lines.zh: : 到这步为止，这可比你那话儿在我体内的次数多多了。

lines.en: : Don’t remind me.
lines.zh: : 别提醒我。

lines.en: : You want to know the weirdest part of all of it, though? Any time I try to bring that up to the other girls, they just...change topics. And completely ignore what I said.
lines.zh: : 不过你想知道这里面最怪的部分是什么吗？每次我试着跟其他女生提起，她们就……岔开话题。完全当我没说过。

lines.en: : Yeah...I’ve noticed that too.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我也注意到了。

lines.en: : Why doesn’t anyone think it’s weird? That we have years worth of memories packed into one...and that even the holidays aren’t properly lining up with the seasons anymore?
lines.zh: : 为什么没人觉得这很怪？明明我们把好几年的记忆塞进了一年里……而且连节日都跟季节对不上了？

lines.en: : Is it really just us two and Maya who understand that?
lines.zh: : 真的只有我们两个和 Maya 明白这一点吗？

lines.en: : Saying we understand it might be a bit too generous as neither of us have any idea what that even means.
lines.zh: : 说我们“明白”可能有点抬举自己了，毕竟我们俩连这到底意味着什么都不知道。

lines.en: : True. But we know it’s happening- which is more than most can say.
lines.zh: : 也是。但我们知道它在发生——这已经比大多数人说得出口的多了。

lines.en: : You’re...really taking in a lot of information about this whole reset thing, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你……真的在消化关于这个“重置”的一大堆信息啊，是不是？

lines.en: : I’m naturally curious...about all sorts of things. And I think you’d have to be insane to not try and understand anything after being dropped into a situation like this.
lines.zh: : 我天生就好奇……对各种各样的事都好奇。而且我觉得，被扔进这么个处境里还不去试着搞明白点什么的人，那才叫疯了。

lines.en: : Is any of it real? Are we real?
lines.zh: : 这些有哪一样是真的吗？我们是真的吗？

lines.en: : Just how deep does all of this go?
lines.zh: : 这一切到底有多深？

lines.en: : At this rate, you’ll be telling all of us and we won’t even need Maya anymore.
lines.zh: : 照这个势头，你很快就能把这些讲给我们所有人听，那我们就连 Maya 都不需要了。

lines.en: : Maybe we don’t need her to begin with?
lines.zh: : 也许我们从一开始就不需要她？

lines.en: : Anyone can do the reset thingy, right? Not just her.
lines.zh: : 谁都能做那个重置什么的，对吧？不只是她。

lines.en: : If that’s the case...
lines.zh: : 如果是这样……

lines.en: : I think I want to try it next time.
lines.zh: : 我想下一次我来试试。

lines.en: : Do you think she’ll teach me how if I ask?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我开口问的话，她会教我吗？

lines.en: : I can’t say for sure, but...probably not.
lines.zh: : 我说不准，不过……大概不会。

lines.en: : Maya doesn’t exactly like change.
lines.zh: : Maya 不太喜欢改变。

lines.en: : I don’t think any of us do. I mean, if I liked this, I wouldn’t be losing sleep over it. I wouldn’t feel like I’m the only one going insane for realizing things everyone around me just...ignores.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们谁都不喜欢。我是说，如果我喜欢这种事，我就不会为它失眠了。我也不会因为想明白了周围所有人都……直接无视的事情，就觉得自己是唯一一个快疯掉的人。

lines.en: : You still have me. And despite your tendency to take pictures of me when I’m sleeping, I still think you’re surprisingly sane.
lines.zh: : 你还有我啊。而且尽管你有在我睡着时偷拍我的癖好，我还是觉得你出奇地清醒。

lines.en: : I’ve got another question.
lines.zh: : 我还有一个问题。

lines.en: : I’m sure you have hundreds so just...ask me whenever you think of one instead of wasting words on warning me first.
lines.zh: : 我猜你有几百个，所以……想到就直接问吧，别浪费话先预告我。

lines.en: : I felt like this one deserved a warning due to its depressing nature.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这个问题比较丧，值得先预警一下。

lines.en: : Uh-oh.
lines.zh: : 哦豁。

lines.en: scene ayanebeachtrip15

lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : Makoto’s dad...
lines.zh: : Makoto 的爸爸……

lines.en: : That...was the first time anything like that has ever happened before, right?
lines.zh: : 那……是有史以来第一次发生这种事，对吧？

lines.en: : As far as I know, yes...
lines.zh: : 据我所知，是的……

lines.en: : But Maya’s made it sound like other people have met similar fates in the past.
lines.zh: : 不过 Maya 说得好像过去也有人遭遇过类似的命运。

lines.en: : Did those people come back?
lines.zh: : 那些人回来了吗？

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure we were among them, so...I’m going to say yes.
lines.zh: : 我很确定我们就在他们之中，所以……我会说，回来了。

lines.en: : Does that mean Makoto’s dad might come back too?
lines.zh: : 那是不是意味着 Makoto 的爸爸也有可能回来？

lines.en: : I hope so.
lines.zh: : 希望如此吧。

lines.en: : It’s so weird how time is moving both forward and backward at the same time.
lines.zh: : 时间同时在向前走又向后走，这真是太怪了。

lines.en: : How people who should be gone wind up coming back...how our memories get reverted...and how new things are still happening every day according to Maya.
lines.zh: : 本该消失的人最后又回来了……我们的记忆被倒回……而按 Maya 的说法，每天又仍有新的事情在发生。

lines.en: : How do we know that this hasn’t ever even happened before? That we’ve never had this conversation?
lines.zh: : 我们怎么知道这一切从来没有发生过？我们从来没有过这段对话？

lines.en: : We...don’t.
lines.zh: : 我们……不知道。

lines.en: : Exactly. We don’t.
lines.zh: : 正是。我们不知道。

lines.en: : Aren’t you worried of knowing too much, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你就不怕知道得太多吗？

lines.en: scene ayanebeachtrip16
: Should I be?
lines.zh: : 我应该怕吗？

lines.en: : I know I am. But I’ve also been repeatedly told that finding out anything about my past might result in my brain imploding, so...yeah.
lines.zh: : 我知道我怕。而且已经有人反复警告过我，查出任何关于我过去的事都可能导致我的大脑爆炸，所以……是啊。

lines.en: : I guess it would be kind of hard to not worry about something like that, yeah.
lines.zh: : 我想，这种事想不担心也难吧。

lines.en: : What if we all have something like that? Key memories that whatever is controlling this world doesn’t want us to have back?
lines.zh: : 如果我们每个人都有类似的东西呢？那种掌控这个世界的什么东西不想要我们拿回去的关键记忆？

lines.en: : You mean, like...God?
lines.zh: : 你是说，比如……神？

lines.en: : Is that something you believe in?
lines.zh: : 你信这个吗？

lines.en: scene ayanebeachtrip17
: I did.
lines.zh: : 以前信。

lines.en: : But now?
lines.zh: : 但现在？

lines.en: : I’m not so sure anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不太确定了。

lines.en: : If God is real, what is this supposed to be?
lines.zh: : 如果神真的存在，那这一切算什么？

lines.en: : A test?
lines.zh: : 一场考验？

lines.en: : What are we supposed to gain from this...incomplete knowledge of how the world works when we can’t even share it with anyone else?
lines.zh: : 当我们连跟别人分享都做不到的时候，这种对世界运作方式的不完全认知，又能让我们得到什么？

lines.en: : Beats me. But I’ll leave the critical thinking to you on account of the whole mind implosion thing.
lines.zh: : 问倒我了。不过鉴于我大脑会爆炸那档子事，深度思考就交给你了。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I’m just thinking out loud at this point anyway.
lines.zh: : 没问题。反正我现在也只是把想法说出来而已。

lines.en: : Look at you, learning to share your thoughts instead of keeping them all to yourself.
lines.zh: : 看看你，学会把想法说出来了，而不是全都闷在自己心里。

lines.en: scene ayanebeachtrip18
: Yes...look at me.
lines.zh: : 是啊……看看我。

lines.en: : No, seriously. Look at me. I bought this swimsuit with you in mind and you’ve done nothing but stare at the water for the last ten minutes.
lines.zh: : 不，说真的。看看我。我买这件泳衣就是为了给你看的，结果你这十分钟一直在盯着水面。

lines.en: scene black
Our talk about the inner workings of the world grinds to a halt as Ayane resets her mind (No pun intended) and refocuses on the real reason I think she came here today.
lines.zh: 我们关于世界内部运作的谈话戛然而止，Ayane 重置了一下自己的大脑（此处没有双关），重新把注意力放到了我认为她今天来这儿的真正理由上。

lines.en: To get away from everything.
lines.zh: 逃离一切。

lines.en: To take a break from this great new burden and remind herself that, beneath the mountain of troubles she’s taken it upon herself to excavate-
lines.zh: 从这个崭新的重担里喘口气，提醒自己：在她主动揽下、决心要挖开的那一堆麻烦之下——

lines.en: She is still young.
lines.zh: 她依然年轻。

lines.en: That she still has the rest of her school life ahead of her and that she shouldn’t have to worry about caring for me or Maya when all that should matter to her is herself.
lines.zh: 她的校园生活还剩下一大半，她本不该操心照顾我或 Maya，她唯一该在乎的人就是她自己。

lines.en: But that is just the type of person she is.
lines.zh: 但她偏偏就是这种人。

lines.en: Someone with more love inside of her than she has ever been shown.
lines.zh: 一个心里装着的爱，远比别人给过她的多得多的人。

lines.en: Why?
lines.zh: 为什么？

lines.en: Why does she have no regard for the way she feels?
lines.zh: 为什么她一点都不顾及自己的感受？

lines.en: Why would she sacrifice this brief respite for the chance to reflect on how there is no respite for those like us at all?
lines.zh: 为什么她愿意牺牲这短暂的喘息，只为了去反思——像我们这样的人，根本就没有喘息可言？

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: And I will not find out today- for I leave her as soon as the sun sets.
lines.zh: 而今天我不会找到答案——因为太阳一落山，我就离开了她。

lines.en: And I make my way over to someone who was smart enough to avoid it in the first place.
lines.zh: 我走向某个聪明到从一开始就躲开了这一切的人。
